title: Pagination
summary: Page links now keep digits the same width while paging, every link presses to 97% and returns in 180ms (Previous/Next used 98% and 200ms), and the hover fill no longer sticks after a tap on touch screens. Layout and sizes are unchanged.
why: Untitled UI and Mantine use tabular numerals for page numbers so the row does not jiggle when going from 9 to 10.
HeroUI presses interactive items to 0.97; Previous/Next were at 0.98 while page numbers were 0.97.
Hover fills should only appear on hover-capable pointers (shadcn, Radix Themes); otherwise a tapped page keeps a grey tile.
states: Page link / default: 32x32, radius 8, no fill, text #707070 14/500, tabular numerals.
Page link / hover (mouse only): fill #F5F5F5, text #5E5E5E.
Page link / active (current page): fill #F5F5F5, 1px border #E9EAEB, text #484848.
figmaSteps: Page number text: turn on Inter 'tabular figures' (tnum) for the page link and the summary text. Size, weight and colours do not change.
Hover variant (mouse only): fill #F5F5F5, text #5E5E5E on inactive page links and on Previous/Next. Do not design a touch hover.
Pressed variant: scale 97% for page links AND Previous/Next (use 0.97 for all). Prototype: 80ms in, 180ms out, spring-like ease out (cubic-bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Nothing else changes: link 32x32 (Previous/Next 32 high, 10px side padding), gap 4px, radius 8, active page fill #F5F5F5 with a 1px #E9EAEB border.
notes: Not implemented: collapsing to 'Page X of Y' on mobile. A real text node would duplicate visible text in jsdom tests; a CSS-only version (pseudo-element) is possible but would hide the direct page-number links below 640px, which is a product decision. It is also not needed: the widest default state (Previous, 1 ... 5 6 7 ... 12, Next) is about 320px by my estimate (9 controls x 32px + gaps) and fits at 360px; scenarios 08 and 09 show the 7-control default at 360px.
Press feedback already came from Button (v2); this change only unifies the scale and the return time. Hold-state captures use design/figma-reports/press-capture.mjs (mouse button held).

Hover gating re-declares the ghost-variant fill as 'hover:bg-transparent' plus a gated hover fill. It could not be done in button.tsx (not in scope), so the same fill is declared once in Pagination. Verified: the desktop hover fill still applies (#F5F5F5). Touch behaviour was reasoned from the CSS, not tested on a device.
Focus rings were already visible via Button (1px, offset 3px); no change needed.
Research conclusions in 'why' come from the task brief; I did not re-verify them against each library.
